description: This PHP class 'PimReportDataAPI' extends a report data API to handle specific report data retrieval and validation for PIM (Personal Information Management) reports in the OrangeHRM system. It manages report generation services and input validation for API requests related to PIM reports.

classes.name: PimReportDataAPI
classes.description: A class that manages report data retrieval and validation for PIM reports within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ReportGeneratorService instance used for report operations.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the specific report object based on the request parameters; throws an exception if the report name is invalid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Constructs and returns validation rules for the 'get all' API method, including report ID validation.
